caseNameFull: Oliver H. Smith, Jr., in Error v. Washington-Southern Railway Company
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Ralph D.. Fleharty and Mr. J. S. Easby-Smith for plaintiff in error., Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. J. S. Flannery, Mr. G. B. Craighill and Mr. W. C. Carpenter for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Macfarland v. Brown, 187 U. S. 239, 246; Mac*651farland v. Byrnes, 187 U. S. 246; Earle v. Myers, 207 U. S. 244; Coe v. Armour Fertilizer Works, 237 U. S. 413, 418-419.

Mr. Ralph D.. Fleharty and Mr. J. S. Easby-Smith for plaintiff in error. Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. J. S. Flannery, Mr. G. B. Craighill and Mr. W. C. Carpenter for defendant in error.
